WITH scada AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        DUID,
        SCADAVALUE,
        INTERVAL_MWH
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_UNIT_SCADA/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS s
),

du AS (
    SELECT
        DUID,
        REGIONID
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DU_DETAIL_SUMMARY/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS d
),

region_sum AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID,
        TOTALDEMAND,
        NET_DEMAND,
        GENERATION_MARGIN
    FROM OPENROWSET(
        BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/DISPATCH_REGION_SUM/*.parquet',
        FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS r
),

trading_price AS (
    SELECT
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID,
        RRP,
        PRICE_STATUS
        FROM OPENROWSET(
            BULK 'https://stcapstonegovdev01.dfs.core.windows.net/capstone/data-processed/ungoverned/s0/r1/TRADING_PRICE/*.parquet',
            FORMAT = 'PARQUET'
    ) AS t
),

consumer AS (
    SELECT
        s.SETTLEMENTDATE,
        s.DUID,
        d.REGIONID,
        s.SCADAVALUE,
        s.INTERVAL_MWH,
        r.TOTALDEMAND,
        r.NET_DEMAND,
        r.GENERATION_MARGIN,
        t.RRP,
        t.PRICE_STATUS
    FROM scada AS s

    LEFT JOIN du AS d
        on s.DUID = d.DUID
    
    LEFT JOIN region_sum AS r
        ON d.REGIONID = r.REGIONID
        AND s.SETTLEMENTDATE = r.SETTLEMENTDATE

    LEFT JOIN trading_price AS t
        ON d.REGIONID = t.REGIONID
        AND s.SETTLEMENTDATE = t.SETTLEMENTDATE
),

consumer_report AS (
    SELECT 
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID,
        COUNT(*) AS RECORD_COUNT,
        COUNT(DISTINCT DUID) AS UNIT_COUNT,
        SUM(INTERVAL_MWH) AS TOTAL_INTERVAL_MWH,
        AVG(SCADAVALUE) AS AVG_SCADA_VALUE,
        MAX(TOTALDEMAND) AS TOTALDEMAND,
        MAX(NET_DEMAND) AS NET_DEMAND,
        MAX(GENERATION_MARGIN) AS REGION_GENERATION_MARGIN,
        MAX(RRP) AS RRP,
        SUM(INTERVAL_MWH) * MAX(RRP) AS ESTIMATED_INTERVAL_VALUE,
        SUM(CASE WHEN REGIONID IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NULL_REGION_ROWS,
        SUM(CASE WHEN TOTALDEMAND IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NULL_DEMAND_ROWS,
        SUM(CASE WHEN RRP IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NULL_PRICE_ROWS,
        SUM(CASE WHEN SCADAVALUE IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NULL_SCADA_ROWS,
        SUM(CASE WHEN INTERVAL_MWH IS NULL THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS NULL_MWH_ROWS  

    FROM consumer
    GROUP BY
        SETTLEMENTDATE,
        REGIONID
)

SELECT
    COUNT(*) AS REPORT_ROWS,
    SUM(RECORD_COUNT) AS CONSUMER_ROWS,
    SUM(UNIT_COUNT) AS UNIT_COUNT_SUM,
    SUM(TOTAL_INTERVAL_MWH) AS TOTAL_MWH,
    SUM(ESTIMATED_INTERVAL_VALUE) AS TOTAL_VALUE,
    SUM(NULL_SCADA_ROWS) AS NULL_SCADA_ROWS,
    SUM(NULL_MWH_ROWS) AS NULL_MWH_ROWS,
    SUM(NULL_REGION_ROWS) AS NULL_REGION_ROWS,
    SUM(NULL_DEMAND_ROWS) AS NULL_DEMAND_ROWS,
    SUM(NULL_PRICE_ROWS) AS NULL_PRICE_ROWS
FROM consumer_report;
